basic_details.job_title: IGRUA Examination Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) has released the official notification for the post of Examination Manager. The last date to send the application by email is 02 November 2026. Further details are available at igrua.gov.in.

qualification.details: Educational Qualifications: Must have undergone an "Instructor's Techniques Course or Equivalent" and be able to demonstrate an understanding of the CAR-66 and CAR-147 regulatory requirements. AND/OR Hold a CAR-66 Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Licence in Mechanical Category. OR Have BAMEL or BAMEC of HA & JE category / equivalent modules of B1.1 Category. | Experience Requirements: Minimum 5 years of working experience in aviation industry out of which 02 years worked in any DGCA approved CAT.G / CAR 147 (Basic) Maintenance Training Organization. | Age Limit: Maximum 62 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. | Mode of Appointment: Contractual for 11 months, extendible. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IGRUA Examination Manager at a Glance

rows.details: Instructor's Techniques Course or Equivalent with CAR-66/CAR-147 understanding, or CAR-66 AME Licence, or BAMEL/BAMEC of HA & JE category / B1.1 equivalent modules

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their applications by email to [email protected] . While applying by email, candidates must clearly mention the title of the advertised post in the subject line: “APPLICATION – Examination Manager IGRUA/ADVT/34/2026” . All documents must be combined into one single PDF file before sending, ordered as follows: first the CV, then educational certificates from 10th onward, and then experience certificates from earliest to latest.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualifications: Must have undergone an "Instructor's Techniques Course or Equivalent" and be able to demonstrate an understanding of the CAR-66 and CAR-147 regulatory requirements. AND/OR Hold a CAR-66 Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Licence in Mechanical Category. OR Have BAMEL or BAMEC of HA & JE category / equivalent modules of B1.1 Category. Experience Requirements: Minimum 5 years of working experience in aviation industry out of which 02 years worked in any DGCA approved CAT.G / CAR 147 (Basic) Maintenance Training Organization. Age Limit: Maximum 62 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. Mode of Appointment: Contractual for 11 months, extendible. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test/interview. Online interviews will be conducted as required, with links shared on the candidate's email ID a day before.

rows.event: Last date of receipt of applications

faq.question: Q1. Is the Examination Manager post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely contractual for a duration of 11 months and is extendible, but it does not confer any right for regular appointment or absorption.

faq.question: Q2. What additional allowances are provided along with the basic remuneration?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a remuneration of ₹70,000 per month along with a Transport Allowance of ₹1,800 per month and an Aviation Allowance of ₹300 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required email subject line for submitting the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must include the exact subject line: “APPLICATION – Examination Manager IGRUA/ADVT/34/2026”.

faq.question: Q5. How should the application documents be formatted before emailing?
faq.answer: All documents must be combined into one single PDF file containing the CV first, followed by educational certificates from 10th onward, and experience certificates from earliest to latest.
